text:
Maya: quick q — we cherry-picked fix from main into release/1.4.x (PR #4521). What's our tagging rule here? do we bump patch to v1.4.3 or use buildmeta on v1.4.2+?

Oz: my vote: bump patch to v1.4.3. If it's a straightforward bugfix that doesn't change behavior, patch is correct per semver.

Sam: depends — if the cherry-pick also includes a small API tweak we should consider minor. But I looked, it's just a null-pointer guard. patch feels right.

Lee: agree patch. Also we should make the changelog entry and mark it as a backport in the release notes so user-facing docs reflect it.

Anika: proposal we standardize for backports: always create a new patch tag (vX.Y.Z+0) and include `+cherry.<pr>` as build metadata in CI artifacts for provenance. That avoids ambiguity between buildmeta-only vs tag bump.

Maya: can we do annotated tag and let deploybot pick it up? e.g.:

```
# on release/1.4.x
git checkout release/1.4.x
git tag -a v1.4.3 -m "backport: fix NPE (cherry-picked PR #4521)"
git push origin v1.4.3
```

Sam: also add a changelog fragment: `chore(release): v1.4.3 — backport fix for X (#4521)` under Unreleased. We'll aggregate later.

DeployBot: :robot_face: created release candidate v1.4.3-rc.1 for branch release/1.4.x (triggered by @Maya). Artifacts uploaded: sha abcd1234.

Lee: for rollout, canary plan: 2% for 30m, check error rate and latency. If green, 20% for 60m, then full. Rollback plan: revert tag and promote previous image. If error rate > 1% during canary -> immediate rollback.

Anika: add-process-note: PRs that are cherry-picks must have label `backport` and include a one-line `backport: reason` in the PR body. DeployBot will enforce.

Oz: +1. I'll add a small check in the release pipeline to prevent auto-increment without `backport` label for release branches (edgecase: emergency hotpatches will be exempt).

Sam: tiny nit: if multiple backports land in same window, we should sequentially increment patches (v1.4.3, v1.4.4) and include separate changelog lines. No compound buildmeta juggling.

Maya: sounds good. I'll tag now and kick canary.

DeployBot: :white_check_mark: v1.4.3 tag pushed and artifacts promoted to canary pool. Canary started at 2%. Monitoring: /dash/rollouts/v1.4.3

Maya: thanks all — leaving a note in the release ticket with the cherry-pick provenance and rollback steps.

Oz: thanks, nice and tidy.

Anika: we should doc this policy in release playbook (short bullet list) so oncall and release leads follow it.

Maya: created PR in infra docs: "release: backport tagging policy". linking here: https://internal/docs/release/backport-policy

Sam: :thumbsup:
